newsitem.title: JAPAN: Nisshinbo to invest 10 bln yen in new U.S. plant.
newsitem.headline: Nisshinbo to invest 10 bln yen in new U.S. plant.

text.p: Nisshinbo Industries Inc said on Thursday it would invest 10 billion yen to build a brake parts plant in Atlanta in the United States.
"We will produce disc pads and brake linings (for cars)," a Nisshinbo spokesman said. He said the new plant is expected to start operating in early 1999.
Nisshinbo, a cotton spinner, started production of brake parts in Michigan in March 1996 to supply U.S. carmakers.
It now aims to increase production to supply Japanese car makers in the United States as well, since they are shifting towards more local production, the spokesman said.
